command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP 1: create CA key"
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/ssh/ca
sudo -n ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -N "" -C "ssh-host-ca@node1" -q
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub
echo "CA pubkey:"; sudo -n cat /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub

echo "STEP 2: sign the host's ed25519 host key with the CA"
sudo -n cp /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub /tmp/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub
sudo -n chmod 644 /tmp/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub
HOSTNAMES="node1,$NODE_NAME,$NODE_IP,localhost"
sudo -n ssh-keygen -s /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -I "node1-host-cert" -h -n "$HOSTNAMES" -V +3650d /tmp/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub
sudo -n mv /tmp/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
echo "Certificate details:"
sudo -n ssh-keygen -L -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub

echo "STEP 3: configure sshd to present the certificate"
if ! grep -q '^HostCertificate ' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then
  echo "HostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config >/dev/null
fi
grep -q '^HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key$' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo "HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config >/dev/null

echo "STEP 4: validate config and restart sshd"
sudo -n sshd -t
sudo -n systemctl restart sshd
sleep 1
systemctl is-active sshd

echo "STEP 5: verify server presents the certificate over the wire"
ssh-keyscan -t ssh-ed25519 "$NODE_IP" 2>/dev/null | head -1

echo "STEP 6: client-side trust test - trust CA only (no host key pinning) and connect"
mkdir -p /tmp/sshtest
CA_PUB=$(sudo -n cat /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub)
printf '@cert-authority %s,%s,%s %s\n' "node1" "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP" "$CA_PUB" > /tmp/sshtest/known_hosts
cat /tmp/sshtest/known_hosts
ssh -vv -o UserKnownHostsFile=/tmp/sshtest/known_hosts -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -p 22 "$NODE_IP" exit 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'certificate|Server host key|Host .* is known|Authenticity' || true
echo DONE
